title: Point masses are at most one
statement: For any type $\Omega$, probability mass function $p$ on $\Omega$, and point $x\in\Omega$, the mass $p(x)$, viewed as a real number, is at most $1$.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is a probability mass function on an arbitrary type $\Omega$
